nodes.excerpt: The person works the board: drags cards, answers questions, reviews diffs. Offline, the same board renders from an IndexedDB mirror and writes queue for reconnect.
nodes.label: PWA board

links.label: queue.ts:712 — writeOrQueue: a write that got no answer is queued and replayed

nodes.excerpt: A pairing code authorizes one registration and authenticates nothing; a session exists only as the answer to a finished WebAuthn ceremony.
nodes.label: Passkey pairing

links.label: pairing.go:14 — a pairing code allows a browser to register a passkey; it does not authenticate
passkey.go:210 — FinishRegistration: one code writes one passkey row and opens the session

nodes.excerpt: One Go binary serves the API, the board's WebSocket, the embedded SPA and the executor. TLS is the only mode; state lives in one SQLite file.
nodes.label: MIKE server

links.label: main.go:28 — main(): flags and env resolve once into an immutable startup config

nodes.excerpt: Cards, threads, and every message row: assistant text, tool calls persisted before they run, tool results, stats and system notes.
nodes.label: Board + task store

links.label: status.go:10 — the four columns: backlog, in_progress, review, done
messages.go:375 — CreateTaskMessage writes the rows a conversation is rebuilt from

nodes.excerpt: A card entering In Progress starts a run: provider slot, memory-gate reservation, worktree, sandbox, then the run itself. Subtasks run children first.
nodes.label: Task executor

links.label: executor.go:1472 — StartTask(projectID, taskID, autostarted)
task.go:429 — HandleMove: leaving In Progress stops the executor; entering it starts one

nodes.excerpt: MIKE's own loop: stream one chat completion, persist the turn, run its tool calls, repeat. No iteration cap — failure limits and the person bound it.
nodes.label: Direct model loop

links.label: loop.go:418 — executeTask: slot, memory gate, sandbox, then the loop
loop.go:1063 — finalizeTurn settles each turn: tools, questions, request_review, failures

nodes.excerpt: An agent extension's WASM adapter translates one agent CLI's wire protocol into MIKE's events; the runner spawns the binary the adapter names.
nodes.label: Agent-provider path

links.label: loader.go:38 — wasmAdapter wraps a wazero WASI reactor module
loop_agent.go:60 — executeTaskWithAgent, the executor's agent-provider branch

nodes.excerpt: request_review lands the card in Review. Only the card's auto flags or a person's commit-and-done click arms a merge; Done means the work reached the target branch.
nodes.label: Review + merge gate

links.label: task.go:832 — HandleCommitAndDone: the person's click that commits and merges
tool_dispatch.go:476 — runRequestReview, the model's completion signal

nodes.excerpt: Git-pinned installs. UI extensions run in opaque-origin iframes; LSP extensions in their own gVisor sandboxes; tool extensions are data that templates one HTTP request.
nodes.label: Extensions

links.label: extensions.go:17 — the extension types: lsp, ui, css, agent, llm, tool, i18n
middleware.go:151 — every /extensions/ response carries a CSP sandbox allow-scripts directive

nodes.excerpt: Named endpoints with a URL, model and optional key. The client POSTs streaming chat completions and accumulates tool calls; agent providers appear in the same list as agent:// URLs.
nodes.label: Model providers

links.label: client.go:167 — LlamaClient handles communication with llama.cpp OpenAI-compatible API
client.go:375 — the request goes to baseURL + /chat/completions

nodes.excerpt: One container per task: runsc runtime, all capabilities dropped, no-new-privileges, optional --network none. Tools reach it over a stdio bridge — no listener, no port.
nodes.label: gVisor task sandbox

links.label: podman_args.go:158 — GVisorCreateArgs: --runtime runsc, --cap-drop ALL, no-new-privileges
sandbox.go:411 — Create builds the task's container, kanban-sandbox-<taskID>

nodes.excerpt: The worktree bind-mounts rw (ro in plan mode) with its .git pointer pinned read-only over it; the project's .git mounts ro at its own path. Results are host files the moment they are written.

links.label: worktree.go:309 — CreateWorktree(projectID, taskID, branchName, sourceBranch)
